title: Fix a stubborn search bug
description: Follow a focused debugging session, from reproduction to a passing regression test.

turns.prompt: Search stops working when I type an uppercase letter. Can you find out why?

events.text: I’ll trace the search filter and check how it compares the query with note titles.

The filter lowercases each title, but leaves the query unchanged. Searching for `Hello` compares it with `hello`, so the match fails.

I’ll normalize the query too and add a regression test.

turns.prompt: Fix it, and handle accidental spaces around the query too.

events.text:
PASS src/components/search.test.tsx
  ✓ matches lowercase queries
  ✓ matches uppercase queries
  ✓ ignores surrounding whitespace
  ✓ shows all notes for an empty query

Tests: 4 passed, 4 total

Fixed. Search now ignores letter case and surrounding spaces.

`Hello`, `HELLO`, and ` hello ` all find the same notes. All four search tests pass.
